text:
alex: Hey team — final pass on release notes for release v2.3 (tomorrow). Need internal announcement copy + pin timing. Deploy window 02:00 UTC, 3h change window. Draft below, please quick review.

maria: I can take copy edits. can we highlight the rollback criteria and known opt-in flags?

alex: Yes — planned rollback if tail-latency > 150ms for >5m on p95 or if error-rate spike >1% for 3m. Pin messaging should list rollback owner and on-call.

jen: Suggest adding the canary cadence: 10% traffic for 15m, then 50% for 10m, then full. Also call out model pinning to rwd/model-v2.3-quant on Dedicated.

kevin: Ops check: Are we pinning DB migrations? none for this deploy, just config flip. Good for low-risk.

opsbot: deploybot: Scheduled deploy created by @alex for 1758643210. Canary policy: 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Autoscale enabled. ETA 02:00 UTC.

luis: Quick heads up — EU region has a maintenance window at 03:00 UTC, so we'll avoid heavy traffic shift then. Maybe start canary at 01:45 UTC to finish before 03:00 gating.

alex: Good catch. Moving canary earlier: start canary at 01:45 UTC, full rollout no later than 02:30 UTC. Update the announcement.

maria: Draft announcement snippet: "Heads-up: Tomorrow 02:00 UTC — rolling deploy v2.3 (model pin rwd/model-v2.3-quant). Canary 01:45 UTC, full by 02:30 UTC. If you own a dependent integration, please verify your flows after 02:30 UTC. Rollback criteria: p95 latency >150ms for 5m or error rate >1% for 3m. Contact @oncall if issues." Thoughts?

jen: Looks good. Add note: "No DB schema changes" to reassure platform teams.

maria: Updated: added "No DB schema changes" and a link to the runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/release-rollbacks-v2.3

kevin: Can we include the deploybot command for manual rollback? e.g. `/deploy rollback rwd/service --to-tag v2.2.9`

alex: Yes, append that in the ops section. Also add owner matrix: Rollback owner: @kevin, Canary monitor: @jen, comms pin: @maria.

opsbot: deploybot: Canary schedule updated per request. Canary start: 1758645500 (01:45 UTC). Canary percentages: 10% for 15m -> 50% for 10m -> rollout.

luis: One more ask — please add token-level cost note for platform: "Expected cost delta ~+4% due to quant fallback behavior; monitoring in Console -> Billing -> Token-costs."

alex: Added. Final ask: pin this message in #eng-releases at T-18h. Who can pin? @maria?

maria: I can pin after copycheck. I'll post the final announce at 08:00 UTC today for internal preview.

jen: I'll run one last canary dry run in staging with identical canary script at 20:00 UTC. If all good, green to go.

kevin: Ops preflight checklist: smoke test, load test spike 2x for 10m, alert hooks validated. I'll run them at 23:30 UTC.

alex: Perfect. Action items: (1) @maria finalize & pin announcement at 08:00 UTC, (2) @jen staging dry run 20:00 UTC, (3) @kevin ops preflight 23:30 UTC, (4) @luis monitor region timing, (5) @opsbot keep deploy schedule.

maria: Acked. Will post final copy with bullet points and owners. :thumbsup:

jen: Ack.

kevin: Ack.

opsbot: deploybot: Reminder will be posted 1h before canary start.

alex: Thanks all — closing thread after pin.
